mapper.sql: id , node_key , snapshot_dt , uri , method , total_count , count_2xx , count_3xx , count_4xx , count_5xx , total_cost , max_cost , created_by , created_dt
mapper.insert: insert into monitor_api_snapshot (node_key , snapshot_dt , uri , method , total_count , count_2xx , count_3xx , count_4xx , count_5xx , total_cost , max_cost , created_by , created_dt) values (#{nodeKey} , #{snapshotDt} , #{uri} , #{method} , #{totalCount} , #{count2xx} , #{count3xx} , #{count4xx} , #{count5xx} , #{totalCost} , #{maxCost} , #{createdBy} , now())
mapper.update: update monitor_api_snapshot set id = id where id = #{id}
update monitor_api_snapshot set id = id where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select snapshot_dt as snapshotDt, sum(total_count) as totalCount, sum(count_2xx) as count2xx, sum(count_3xx) as count3xx, sum(count_4xx) as count4xx, sum(count_5xx) as count5xx, sum(total_cost) as totalCost, max(max_cost) as maxCost, round(sum(total_cost) / nullif(sum(total_count), 0), 0) as avgCost from monitor_api_snapshot where 1 = 1
group by snapshot_dt order by snapshot_dt asc

select sum(total_count) as totalCount, sum(count_2xx) as count2xx, sum(count_3xx) as count3xx, sum(count_4xx) as count4xx, sum(count_5xx) as count5xx, sum(total_cost) as totalCost, max(max_cost) as maxCost, round(sum(total_cost) / nullif(sum(total_count), 0), 0) as avgCost from monitor_api_snapshot where 1 = 1

select uri, method, sum(total_count) as totalCount, sum(count_2xx) as count2xx, sum(count_3xx) as count3xx, sum(count_4xx) as count4xx, sum(count_5xx) as count5xx, sum(total_cost) as totalCost, max(max_cost) as maxCost, round(sum(total_cost) / nullif(sum(total_count), 0), 0) as avgCost, (sum(count_4xx) + sum(count_5xx)) as errorCount, round((sum(count_4xx) + sum(count_5xx)) / nullif(sum(total_count), 0) * 100, 2) as errorRate from monitor_api_snapshot where 1 = 1
group by uri, method order by totalCount desc
